title: The Law Sphere's card wired; every instrument's record printed in the SOP and Decoder; the laboratory correction from the sample's own reads; planted answers
set_out: Wire the Law Sphere's input card into its readings; print every sequencing instrument's full record in the SOP and the Decoder; build the positions reference for the 'where' stage; correct each sequenced sample onto the atlas's conversion scale from its own reads; test instruments with planted answers.
open_at_turnover: The counted readings (islands territory, Met-A at islands) still carry a planted conversion error; healthy ranges for atlas-referenced readings must be rebuilt held-out; the 'where' losses must be re-planted; the report; the sign-off audit; then the leukemia study.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Law Sphere input card wired (edits 237, 241)
entries.what: The card's coin size, temperature, coins per restore and push reach the law-referenced readings; the law block prints held:lost within the write and lost over held.
entries.outcome: Lever map on the known-answer library's saved counts: every input moves the readings it should and no others (coin size 53.5-61.7 kJ/mol moves hold vs law -0.9 % to +13.3 %).

entries.title: Full-chain readiness (edit 239)
entries.what: The sky reading leaves out identification-only cells; sorted libraries refused as mixtures still get the molecule count, genome globe and site counts.
entries.outcome: The sky reading had stopped on 18 of 49 never-used libraries; it now reads them.

entries.title: Instrument records in the SOP and Decoder (edits 243.1-243.11)
entries.what: Every sequencing instrument's full record, generated from the instruments database, printed in the SOP and the Decoder with US spelling and every printed number traced to a measurement record.
entries.outcome: On main (1ea2f439); researcher questions attached (57 had not printed).

entries.title: Positions reference for 'where' (edit 244)
entries.what: Every Law Sphere unit and globe region with hg19 coordinates, UCSC island, nearest gene and array probe count, built from public UCSC files.
entries.outcome: 28,217,448 CpGs rebuilt; all 813,951 array probes land on their recorded positions.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); positions from UCSC hg19

entries.title: Laboratory correction from the sample's own reads (edit 246)
entries.what: Each sequenced sample's site levels and gain rates put on the atlas's conversion scale from its own islands meter.
entries.outcome: Planted 1 % non-conversion: the Law Sphere strays x1.61 -> x1.04, unused islands x1.84 -> x1.05, the clock's gain x1.82 -> x1.03; the counted islands readings not corrected (owed).
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); test library GSM5652214

entries.title: Planted answers
entries.what: Incomplete conversion, losses in fully methylated molecules, losses in firm tiles, planted places for 'where'.
entries.outcome: Conversion met (islands meter +0.00973 against +0.0099); firm-tile losses partly met (+0.00516 against +0.005 to +0.007); 'where' null clean, planted losses missed the counted units (re-plant owed).
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); test library GSM5652214
